When I lost that last race,
I was soooo, sooooo frustrated!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket

Thaaaaaank yoooouuu so muuuuch!!
Power is... surging... straight through meee!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket

Trainer! I'm going to run with all my might!!
Even way, way harder than before!!
